G1537.def:
**ἐκ** (ἐξ),
_prep. with genitive, _
**from out of, from** (_see_ Addendum, p. 492).
This entry is included here, but in the print version the entry is found on p. 492. **ἐκ**, before a vowel ἐξ,
_prep. with genitive, _
of motion outwards, separation from (opposite to εἰς; = Lat. e, ex), **from out of, from among, from**.
I. Of Place,
1. **of motion, out of, forth from, off from**: [[Jhn.6.31|Jhn.6:31]], [[Act.9.3|Act.9:3]], [[Gal.1.8|Gal.1:8]], al.; esp. after verbs of motion, [[Mat.8.28; 17.9|Mat.8:28 17:9]], [[Mrk.1.25; 7.28|Mrk.1:25 7:28]], [[Jhn.1.33; 20.1|Jhn.1:33 20:1]], [[Act.12.7, 17; 27.30|Act.12:7, 17 27:30]], al.; constr. praeg., σώζειν (διας) ἐκ, [[Jude.5|Ju 5]], [[Act.28.4|Act.28:4]]. Metaphorical, [[Mat.7.4|Mat.7:4]], 5, [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]]; ἐκ τ. χειρός (-ῶν), before genitive of person(s), [[Luk.1.74|Luk.1:74]], [[Jhn.10.28, 29, 39|Jhn.10:28, 29, 39]], [[Act.12.4; 24.7|Act.12:4 24:7]], [[Rev.19.2|Rev.19:2]]; πίνειν (which see) ἐκ; of the place from which an action proceeds, [[Luk.5.3|Luk.5:3]] ([[Luk.12.36|cf. 12:36]], [[Jhn.13.4|Jhn.13:4]], [[2Co.2.4|2Co.2:4]]).
2. **Of change from one place or condition to another**: [[Jhn.8.42|Jhn.8:42]], [[Rom.6.13; 13.11|Rom.6:13 13:11]], [[Rev.7.14|Rev.7:14]], al.; with ellips. of verb of motion, [[2Ti.2.26|2Ti.2:26]], [[2Pe.2.21|2Pe.2:21]], [[Rev.2.21|Rev.2:21]], al.
3. Of separation or distinction from a number, before collective or pl. nouns: [[Mat.13.47, 49|Mat.13:47, 49]], [[Jhn.12.1|Jhn.12:1]], [[Act.3.15|Act.3:15]], [[1Pe.1.3|1Pe.1:3]], al.; after εἷς, [[Mat.10.29|Mat.10:29]] [[Luk.17.15|Luk.17:15]], al.; οὐδείς, [[Jhn.7.19|Jhn.7:19]], al.; πολλοί, [[Jhn.11.19|Jhn.11:19]], al.; τις, [[Luk.11.15|Luk.11:15]], al.; τίς, [[Mat.6.27|Mat.6:27]], al.; in partitive phrase as subject of sentence, [[Jhn.16.17|Jhn.16:17]] Hebraistically, ἐκ μέσου before genitive, = ἐκ (Heb. מִתּוֹךְ), [[Mat.13.49|Mat.13:49]], al.
4. **Of position or direction **(so in cl. = ἔξω): ἐκ δεξιῶν (see: δεξιός); ἐξ ἐναντίας, [[Mrk.15.39|Mrk.15:39]] (metaphorically, [[Tit.2.8|Tit.2:8]]); ἐκ ῥιζῶν (i.e., **utterly**), [[Mat.11.20|Mat.11:20]]
II. Of Time,
1. of the point of time from which, **from, since**: ἐκ γενετῆς, [[Jhn.9.1|Jhn.9:1]], cf. [[Mrk.10.20|Mrk.10:20]], [[Luk.23.8|Luk.23:8]], [[Act.24.10|Act.24:10]], al.
2. **Of succession in time**: ἐκ δευτέρου, **a second time**, [[Mrk.14.72|Mrk.14:72]], al., cf. [[Mat.26.44|Mat.26:44]] ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, **from day to day**, [[2Pe.2.8|2Pe.2:8]]
III. Of Origin,
1. **of nativity, lineage, race**: κοίτην (ἐν γαστρί) ἔχειν, [[Rom.9.10|Rom.9:10]], [[Mat.1.18|Mat.1:18]]; γεννᾶν ἐκ, [[Mat.1.3|Mat.1:3]]ff.; γεννᾶσθαι (γίνεσθαι) ἐκ, [[Jhn.3.6; 8.41|Jhn.3:6 8:41]], [[Gal.4.4|Gal.4:4]]; ἐκ πνεύματος (θεοῦ), [[Jhn.1.13|Jhn.1:13]] 3:5ff., al. ἔρχεσθαι, εἶναι, etc., ἐκ τ. πολέως, [[Jhn.1.44|Jhn.1:44]] φυλῆς, [[Luk.2.36|Luk.2:36]], al.; τ. ἐξουσίας Ἡρῴδου, [[Luk.23.7|Luk.23:7]] ὁ ὢν ἐκ τ. γῆς, [[Jhn.3.31|Jhn.3:31]]
2. **Of the author, occasion or source**: [[Mat.5.37|Mat.5:37]], [[Jhn.2.16|Jhn.2:16]], [[Rom.2.29|Rom.2:29]], [[1Co.8.6|1Co.8:6]], [[Gal.5.8|Gal.5:8]], al.; ἐκ (τ. θεοῦ, [[1Co.7.7|1Co.7:7]], [[2Co.5.1|2Co.5:1]], [[1Jn.4.7|1Jn.4:7]]; ἐκ τ. πατρός, [[Jhn.6.65|Jhn.6:65]], al.; ἐκ τ. γῆς ἐστιν, λαλεῖ, [[Jhn.3.31|Jhn.3:31]] εκ καρδίας, [[Rom.6.17|Rom.6:17]], cf. [[Mrk.12.30|Mrk.12:30]], [[1Ti.1.5|1Ti.1:5]]; ἐκ ψυχῆς, [[Eph.6.6|Eph.6:6]], [[Col.3.23|Col.3:23]]; ἐκ πίστεως, [[Rom.14.23|Rom.14:23]] κρίνειν ἐκ, [[Luk.19.22|Luk.19:22]], [[Rev.20.12|Rev.20:12]].
3. **Of the agent, after passive verbs**: [[Mat.15.5|Mat.15:5]], [[Mrk.7.11|Mrk.7:11]], [[2Co.2.2|2Co.2:2]], al.; frequently in Re after αδικεῖσθαι (2:11), etc.
4. **Of cause, dependence, source of supply**: τ. πόνου (των), [[Rev.16.10, 11|Rev.16:10, 11]]; τ. φωνῶν, [[Rev.8.13|Rev.8:13]] ἐκ τούτου, [[Jhn.6.66; 19.12|Jhn.6:66 19:12]] (but see Meyer, in ll.); ἐκ θεοῦ λαλεῖν, [[2Co.2.17|2Co.2:17]] ἐκ τ. ἀληθείας, [[Jhn.18.37|Jhn.18:37]], [[1Jn.3.19|1Jn.3:19]]; ὁ ἐκ πίστεως, [[Rom.3.26; 4.16|Rom.3:26 4:16]]; οἱ (ὄντες) ἐκ περιτομῆς, [[Act.11.2|Act.11:2]], [[Rom.4.12|Rom.4:12]], [[Gal.2.12|Gal.2:12]], [[Col.4.11|Col.4:11]]; πίνειν ἐκ, [[Mat.26.29|Mat.26:29]], [[Mrk.14.25|Mrk.14:25]], [[Jhn.4.13|Jhn.4:13]], al.; θερίζειν, [[Gal.6.8|Gal.6:8]] μετέχειν ἐκ (= partit. genitive), [[1Co.10.13|1Co.10:13]] with inf., ἐκ τοῦ ἔχειν, [[2Co.8.11|2Co.8:11]]
5. **Of material**: [[Mat.27.29|Mat.27:29]], [[Jhn.2.15; 19.2|Jhn.2:15 19:2]], [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]], [[1Co.11.12|1Co.11:12]], [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]], al.; allied to which is its use of price (= cl. genitive): [[Mat.27.7|Mat.27:7]], cf. [[Mat.20.2|ib. 20:2]], [[Act.1.18|Act.1:18]].
IV. **By attraction = ἐν **(cl.): τὰ ἐκ τ. οἰκιας, [[Mat.24.17|Mat.24:17]] τ. ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν, [[Mrk.5.30|Mrk.5:30]] (see Field, in l.); ὁ πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, [[Luk.11.13|Luk.11:13]]
V. **Adverbial phrases**: ἐξ ἀνάγκης, [[2Co.9.7|2Co.9:7]], [[Heb.7.12|Heb.7:12]]; ἐξ ἰσότητος, [[2Co.8.13|2Co.8:13]] ἐκ μέρους, [[1Co.12.27; 13.9-12|1Co.12:27 13:9-12]]; ἐκ μέτρου, [[Jhn.3.34|Jhn.3:34]] ἐκ συμφώνου, [[1Co.7.5|1Co.7:5]]
VI. in composition, ἐκ signifies,
1. **procession, removal**: ἐκβαίνω, ἐκβάλλω.
2. **Opening out, unfolding**: ἐκτείνω; metaphorically, ἐξαγγάλλω.
3. **Origin**: ἔκγονος.
4. **Completeness**: ἐξαπορέω (see M, _Pr._, 237), ἐκπληρόω, ἐκτελέω.
(AS)

G1525.def:
**εἰσ-έρχομαι**,
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
**to go in** or **into, enter**: [[Mat.9.25|Mat.9:25]], [[Luk.7.45|Luk.7:45]], al.; before εἰς, [[Mat.10.12|Mat.10:12]], [[Mrk.2.1|Mrk.2:1]], al.; before διά (πύλης, θύρας, etc.), [[Mat.7.13|Mat.7:13]], [[Jhn.10.1|Jhn.10:1]], al.; ὑπὸ τ. στέγην, [[Mat.8.8|Mat.8:8]] with adv.: ὅπου, [[Mrk.14.14|Mrk.14:14]], [[Heb.6.20|Heb.6:20]]; ὧδε, [[Mat.22.12|Mat.22:12]] ἔσω, [[Mat.26.58|Mat.26:58]] before πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.15.43|Mrk.15:43]], [[Luk.1.28|Luk.1:28]], [[Act.10.3; 11.3; 16.40; 17.2; 28.8|Act.10:3 11:3 16:40 17:2 28:8]], [[Rev.3.20|Rev.3:20]]; of demons taking possession, [[Mrk.9.25|Mrk.9:25]], [[Luk.8.30|Luk.8:30]] 22:3, [[Jhn.13.27|Jhn.13:27]]; of food, [[Mat.15.11|Mat.15:11]], [[Act.11.8|Act.11:8]]. Metaphorical, of thoughts, [[Luk.9.46|Luk.9:46]] εἰς κόπον, [[Jhn.4.38|Jhn.4:38]] εἰς πειρασμόν, [[Mat.26.41|Mat.26:41]], [[Luk.22.40, 46|Luk.22:40, 46]]; of hope as an anchor, [[Heb.6.19|Heb.6:19]] βοαί, [[Jas.5.4|Jas.5:4]] πνεῦμα ζωῆς, [[Rev.11.11|Rev.11:11]] εἰς τ. κόσμον (cf. [[Wis.2.24; 14.14|Wis.2:24 14:14]], [[Jhn.18.37|Jhn.18:37]]), [[Rom.5.12|Rom.5:12]], [[Heb.10.5|Heb.10:5]]; in counterparts of Jewish Aram. phrases relating to the theocracy (cf. Dalman, _Words_, 116ff.): εἰς τ. γάμους, [[Mat.25.10|Mat.25:10]] εἰς τ. χάραν τ. κυρίου, [[Mat.25.21, 23|Mat.25:21, 23]]; εἰς τ. ζωήν, [[Mat.18.8, 9; 19.17|Mat.18:8, 9 19:17]], [[Mrk.9.43, 45|Mrk.9:43, 45]]; εἰς τ. βασιλ. τ. οὐρανῶν, [[Mat.5.20; 7.21|Mat.5:20 7:21]], al. (see: βασιλεία); εἰς τ. κατάπαυσιν, [[Heb.3.11, 18; 4.1|Heb.3:11, 18 4:1]]ff.; εἰς τ. δόξαν, [[Luk.24.26|Luk.24:26]] εἰσ. καὶ ἐξερχ., **to go in and out** (like Heb. בוֹא וְצֵאת, [[Deu.28.6|Deu.28:6]], etc.), of familiar intercourse, [[Act.1.21|Act.1:21]] figuratively, of moral freedom, [[Jhn.10.9|Jhn.10:9]] (cf. ἐπ-, παρ-, συν-εισέρχομαι).
(AS)

G1565.def:
**ἐκεῖνος**, -η, -ο
(ἐκεῖ), [in LXX chiefly for הַהוּא ,הוּא, and cogn. forms ;]
_demonstr. pron._,
**that** person or thing (_ille_), implying remoteness as compared with οὗτος (_hic_);
1. absol., emphatic **he, she, it**: opposite to οὗτος, [[Luk.18.14|Luk.18:14]], [[Jas.4.15|Jas.4:15]]; ἡμεῖς, [[Heb.12.25|Heb.12:25]] ὑμεῖς, [[Mrk.4.11|Mrk.4:11]] ἄλλοι, [[Jhn.9.9|Jhn.9:9]] ἐγώ, [[Jhn.3.30|Jhn.3:30]] to persons named, Mk 16:[10, 13, 20], [[Jhn.2.21|Jhn.2:21]]; of one (absent) who is not named, contemptuously (Abbott, _JG_, §§2385, 2732), [[Jhn.7.11; 9.28|Jhn.7:11 9:28]]; with respect, of Christ, [[1Jo.2.6 3:3|1Jo.2:6 3:3]], al.; referring to a preceding noun, Mrk.16:[10], [[Jhn.7.45|Jhn.7:45]]; resumption of a participial subject, [[Jhn.1.33; 9.37; 10.1|Jhn.1:33 9:37 10:1]], [[Rom.14.14|Rom.14:14]], al. (on its reference in [[Jhn.19.35|Jhn.19:35]], see Westc, in l.; Moffatt, _Intr._, 568; Sanday, _Fourth Gospel_, 77ff.).
2. As _adj._, joined, like οὗτος, to a noun with the article: [[Mat.7.25|Mat.7:25]], [[Mrk.3.24|Mrk.3:24]], [[Jhn.18.15|Jhn.18:15]], al.; esp. of time, past or future: ἐν τ. ἡμέραις ἐ., [[Mat.3.1|Mat.3:1]], [[Mrk.1.9|Mrk.1:9]], [[Act.2.18|Act.2:18]]" (LXX), al.; ἐν ἐ. τ. ἡμέρᾳ, esp of the Parousia, [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[Luk.6.23|Luk.6:23]], [[2Th.1.10|2Th.1:10]], [[2Ti.1.12|2Ti.1:12]]; adverbially, ἐκεινής (sc. ὁδοῦ) = cl. ἐκεινῇ (Bl., §36, 13), **that way**, [[Luk.19.4|Luk.19:4]]
(AS)

G1581.def:
**ἐκ-κόπτω**,
[in LXX for כָּרַת, etc. ;]
**to cut out, cut off, cut down**: of a hand, foot, [[Mat.5.30; 18.8|Mat.5:30 18:8]]; a tree, [[Mat.3.10; 7.19|Mat.3:10 7:19]] [[Luk.3.9; 13.7, 9|Luk.3:9 13:7, 9]]; figuratively, of a branch, [[Rom.11.22|Rom.11:22]] before ἐκ, [[Rom.11.24|Rom.11:24]] metaphorically, τ. ἀφορμήν (cf. [[Job.19.10|Job.19:10]] ἐλπίδα), [[2Co.11.12|2Co.11:12]]†
(AS)

G1598.def:
**ἐκ-πειράζω **
[in LXX: [[Deu.6.16; 8.2, 16|Deu.6:16 8:2, 16]] [[Psa.78.18|Psa.78:18]] (נָסָה pi.) * ;]
= cl. ἐκπειράομαι,
**to put to the proof** or **test, make trial of, tempt**: with accusative, of God, [[Mat.4.7|Mat.4:7]] (LXX), [[Luk.4.12|Luk.4:12]] (ib.), [[1Co.10.9|1Co.10:9]] of Christ, [[Luk.10.25|Luk.10:25]] (Cremer, 497).†
(AS)

G1564.def:
**ἐκεῖθεν **
_adv._, [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;]
1. of place, **thence**: [[Mat.4.21|Mat.4:21]], [[Mrk.6.1|Mrk.6:1]], al.
2. Of time, **thereafter** (see: κἀκεῖθεν).
(AS)

G1522.def:
**είσ-ακούω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַע, also for עָנָה, etc. ;]
**to listen to**, in two senses;
(a) **to obey**: [[1Co.14.21|1Co.14:21]] (cf. [[Deu.1.43|Deu.1:43]], [[Sir.3.6|Sir.3:6]])
(b) **to listen, assent to**; pass., **to be heard**: of persons praying, [[Mat.6.7|Mat.6:7]], [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]]; of the prayer offered, [[Luk.1.13|Luk.1:13]], [[Act.10.31|Act.10:31]] (cf. [[Psa.4.2|Psa.4:2]], [[Sir.34.26|Sir.34:26]]); see Cremer, 624).†
(AS)

G1533.def:
**εἰσ-φέρω **
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא hi. ;]
**to bring in, into**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.5.18-19;|Luk.5:18-19]] before εἰς, [[Mat.6.13|Mat.6:13]], [[Luk.11.4|Luk.11:4]]; ἐπί, [[Luk.12.11|Luk.12:11]] with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς, [[1Ti.6.7|1Ti.6:7]] pass., [[Heb.13.11|Heb.13:11]]†
(AS)

G1544.def:
**ἐκ-βάλλω **
[in LXX chiefly for גָּרַשׁ pi., also for שָׁלַךְ hi., יָצָא hi., יָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;]
1. **to drive, cast** or **send out, to expel**: with accusative of thing(s), mid. (σῖτον), before εἰς, [[Act.27.38|Act.27:38]] pass., [[Mat.15.17|Mat.15:17]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.21.12|Mat.21:12]], [[Mrk.11.15|Mrk.11:15]], al.; δαιμόνια, [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[Mrk.1.34|Mrk.1:34]], al.; id. before ἐκ, [[Mrk.7.26|Mrk.7:26]] παρά, [[Mrk.16.9|Mrk.16:9]] ἐν, [[Mrk.3.22|Mrk.3:22]] (ἐν) τ. ὀνόματι, [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[Mrk.9.38|Mrk.9:38]]; λόγῳ, [[Mat.8.16|Mat.8:16]] before ἔξω, [[Jhn.6.37|Jhn.6:37]] id. with genitive, [[Mrk.12.8|Mrk.12:8]], al.; of expulsion from home, [[Gal.4.30|Gal.4:30]] from the Church, [[3Jn.10|III Jn 10]].
2. In LXX and NT (like _Heb._ יָצָא and Aram. הַנְפֵּק), **to command** or **cause to depart**: [[Mat.9.38|Mat.9:38]], [[Mrk.1.12|Mrk.1:12]] (see Swete, in l.), ib. [[Mrk.1.43; 5.40|Mrk.1:43 5:40]], [[Luk.10.2|Luk.10:2]], [[Jas.2.25|Jas.2:25]]; τ. κρίσιν εἰς νῖκος (_to cause to proceed to its goal_), [[Mat.12.20|Mat.12:20]] (LXX).
3. **to reject** (cl.): τ. ὄνομα ὑμῶς ὡς πονηρόν (cf. [[Deu.25.14|Deu.25:14]]), [[Luk.6.22|Luk.6:22]]; **to leave out**, [[Rev.11.2|Rev.11:2]]
4. **to take, draw** or **pluck out**;
(a) **with violence**: [[Mat.7.5|Mat.7:5]], [[Mrk.9.47|Mrk.9:47]], [[Luk.6.42|Luk.6:42]];
(b) **to bring forth** or **out of**: [[Mat.12.35|Mat.12:35]], [[Luk.10.35|Luk.10:35]].
(AS)

G1515.def:
**εἰρήνη**, -ης, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלוֹם ;]
**peace**;
1. **of public peace, freedom from war**: [[Luk.14.32|Luk.14:32]], [[Act.12.20; 24.2|Act.12:20 24:2]]; of the church, [[Act.9.31|Ac 9:31]].
2. **Of peace between persons, concord, agreement **: [[Mat.10.34|Mat.10:34]], [[Luk.12.51|Luk.12:51]], [[Rom.14.17|Rom.14:17]], [[1Co.7.15|1Co.7:15]], [[Gal.5.22|Gal.5:22]], [[Jas.3.18|Jas.3:18]] ζητεῖν εἰ., [[1Pe.3.11|1Pe.3:11]] διώκειν, [[2Ti.2.22|2Ti.2:22]] ib. before μετὰ πάντων, [[Heb.12.14|Heb.12:14]] by meton., of him who brings peace, [[Eph.2.14|Eph.2:14]]
3. As in LXX (= Heb. שָׁלוֹם, Aram. שְׁלָם), of a state of security and safety: [[Jhn.16.33|Jhn.16:33]], [[Rom.2.10|Rom.2:10]], [[1Th.5.3|1Th.5:3]],́ whence the formulae, ὕπαγε (πορεύου) εἰς εἰ, [[Mrk.5.34|Mrk.5:34]], [[Luk.7.50|Luk.7:50]] (cf. [[1Sa.1.17|1Ki.1:17]], al.; לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם); εἰ. ὑμῖν (שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם), [[Jhn.20.19, 21, 26|Jhn.20:19, 21, 26]]; ἀπολύειν ἐν εἰ., [[Luk.2.29|Luk.2:29]], cf. [[1Co.16.11|1Co.16:11]] ἡ εἰ. ὑμῶν, [[Mat.10.13|Mat.10:13]], [[Luk.10.6|Luk.10:6]]; υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ib.
4. **Of spiritual peace, the peace of Christ's kingdom **(_DCG_, ii, 330f.): [[Luk.1.79; 2.14|Luk.1:79 2:14]] [[Jhn.16.33|Jhn.16:33]], [[Rom.2.10; 5.1; 8.6|Rom.2:10 5:1 8:6]], al.; ὁ κύριος τῆς εἰ., [[2Th.3.16|2Th.3:16]] ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰ., [[Rom.15.33; 16.20|Rom.15:33 16:20]], [[2Co.13.11|2Co.13:11]], al.; in epistolary salutations, [[Rom.1.7|Rom.1:7]], [[1Co.1.3|1Co.1:3]], [[Gal.1.3|Gal.1:3]], [[1Th.1.1|1Th.1:1]], [[1Pe.1.2|1Pe.1:2]], [[2Jn.3|2Jo.3]], [[Rev.1.4|Rev.1:4]], al. (see Cremer, 244).
(AS)

G1540.def:
**ἑκατόν**, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
**a hundred**: [[Mat.13.8, 23|Mat.13:8, 23]] [[Luk.15.4|Luk.15:4]], al.; κατὰ ἑ, [[Mrk.6.40|Mrk.6:40]] εἰς, ἐν ἑ., [[Mrk.4.8, 20|Mrk.4:8, 20]]
(AS)

G1584.def:
**ἐκ-λάμπω **
[in LXX for אוֹר hi., etc. ;]
**to shine forth**: [[Mat.13.43|Mat.13:43]]†
(AS)

G1531.def:
**εἰσ-πορεύομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
**to go into, enter**: [[Luk.8.16; 11.33; 19.30|Luk.8:16 11:33 19:30]]; before εἰς, [[Mrk.1.21; 6.56; 11.2|Mrk.1:21 6:56 11:2]], [[Luk.22.10|Luk.22:10]], [[Act.3.2|Act.3:2]]; πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Act.28.30|Act.28:30]] ὅπου, [[Mrk.5.40|Mrk.5:40]] κατά τ. οἴκους, _house after house_, [[Act.8.3|Act.8:3]] of things (food), [[Mat.15.17|Mat.15:17]], [[Mrk.7.15, 18-19|Mrk.7:15, 18-19]] Metaphorical (cf. εἰοέρχομαι, 2), [[Mrk.4.19|Mrk.4:19]], [[Luk.18.24|Luk.18:24]]; εἰσ. καὶ ἐκπορ., to associate with, before μετά (cf. εἰσέρχομαι), [[Act.9.28|Act.9:28]]†
(AS)

G1590.def:
**ἐκ-λύω **
[in LXX for רָפָה, etc. ;]
1. **to loose, release**.
2. **to unloose**, as a bow-string, **to relax, enfeeble**; pass., **to be faint, grow weary**: [[Mat.15.32|Mat.15:32]], [[Mrk.8.3|Mrk.8:3]]; of mental weariness, [[Gal.6.9|Gal.6:9]], [[Heb.12.3|Heb.12:3]], 5" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G1538.def:
1. **every, every one, each, each one **, Lat. _quisque_, (Homer), etc.; the _singular_ is often joined with a pl. Verb, ἔβαν οἴκονδε ἕκαστος they went home **every one of them **, (Iliad by Homer); ἕκαστος ἐπίστασθε (Xenophon Historicus):—;the _singular_ is also put in apposition with a pl. Noun, Τρῶας ἕκαστον ὑπήλυθε τρόμος (for Τρώων ἕκαστον)) fear seized them **every one **, (Iliad by Homer)
2. in _plural_ **all and each one **, (Homer)
3. more definitely, εἷς ἕκαστος, Lat. _unusquisque_, every single one, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—; καθ᾽ ἕκαστον **singly, by itself **, Lat. _singulatim_, (Plato Philosophus), etc.
4. ὡς ἕκαστοι **each by himself **, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G1542.def: **a hundred times as much ** or **many **, (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G1554.def:
**ἐκ-δίδωμι **
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;]
1. **to surrender, give up, give out**.
2. **to let out for hire** (Hdt.); mid. (as frequently in π.; see MM, _Exp._, xii); **to let out to one's advantage**, [[Mat.21.33, 41|Mat.21:33, 41]], [[Mrk.12.1|Mrk.12:1]], [[Luk.20.9|Luk.20:9]].†
(AS)

G1588.def:
**ἐκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν**
(ἐκλέγω), [in LXX for בָּחַר (so prob. in [[Isa.28.16|Isa.28:16]], [[Pro.17.3|Pro.17:3]], for MT בָּחַן), בָּרִיא, etc. ;]
1. **choice, select** (cl., rarely; Thuc., Plat., al.), hence, **eminent**: [[Rom.16.13|Rom.16:13]] (cf. [[Ezk.27.24|Eze.27:24]]).
2. As in Inscr. (MM, _Exp._, xii), **chosen**; esp. as in LXX, of Israel, **elect, chosen **of God ([[Isa.65.9|Isa.65:9]], [[Psa.105.43|Psa.105:43]], al.); so in NT;
(a) **of Christ**: [[Luk.23.35|Luk.23:35]] (cf. [[Isa.42.1|Isa.42:1]]); figuratively, λίθος, [[1Pe.2.4-6|1Pe.2:4-6]] (LXX);
(b) **of holy angels**: [[1Ti.5.21|1Ti.5:21]]
(with) **of Christians**: [[Mat.24.22, 24|Mat.24:22, 24]], [[Mrk.13.20, 22; 13.27|Mrk.13:20, 22 13:27]], [[2Ti.2.10|2Ti.2:10]], [[1Pe.1.1|1Pe.1:1]]; τ. θεοῦ, [[Luk.18.7|Luk.18:7]], [[Rom.8.33|Rom.8:33]], [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]], [[Tit.1.1|Tit.1:1]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Mat.24.31|Mat.24:31]] ἐ. κυρία, [[2Jn.1|II Jn 1]]; ἀδελφή, [[2Jn.13|II Jn 13]]; γένος, [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX); κλητοὶ καὶ ἐ. κ. πιστοί, [[Rev.17.14|Rev.17:14]] opposite to κλητός (not so in Epp.; see Lft. on [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]]), [[Mat.20.16|Mat.20:16]] (T, WH, txt., R, omit) [[Mat.22.14|Mat.22:14]] (Cremer, 405, 775).†
(AS)

G1504.def:
**εἰκών**, -όνος (cf. ἔοικα),
[in LXX chiefly for צֶלֶם ;]
**an image, likeness**: [[Mat.22.20|Mat.22:20]], [[Mrk.12.16|Mrk.12:16]], [[Luk.20.24|Luk.20:24]], [[Rom.1.23|Rom.1:23]], [[1Co.15.49|1Co.15:49]], [[Rev.13.14, 15; 14.9, 11; 15.2; 16.2; 19.20; 20.4|Rev.13:14, 15 14:9, 11 15:2 16:2 19:20 20:4]]; opposite to σκιά, [[Heb.10.1|Heb.10:1]] of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, [[1Co.11.7|1 Co 11:7]]; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ [[Col.3.10|Col.3:10]] (see Lft., in l.); εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.8.29|Rom.8:29]], [[2Co.3.18|2Co.3:18]]; of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ, [[2Co.4.4|2Co.4:4]], [[Col.1.15|Col.1:15]].† _SYN._: ὁμοίωμα, denoting resemblance, which may however be merely accidental. εἰ. is a _derived_ likeness and like the head on a coin or the parental likeness in a child, implies an archetype. Cf. also εἶδος, _appearance_, not necessarily based on reality; σκιά, a shadowed resemblance; χαρακτήρ, the _impress_ of a stamp; μόρφη (which see), the _form_ as indicative of the inner being.
(AS)

G1562.def:
**ἐκ-δύω **
[in LXX chiefly for פָּשַׁט ;]
**to take of, strip of, strip**: with accusative of person(s) (sc. clothing), [[Mat.27.28|Mat.27:28]] with accusative of person(s) and of thing(s), [[Mat.27.31|Mat.27:31]], [[Mrk.15.20|Mrk.15:20]], [[Luk.10.30|Luk.10:30]]; mid., **to put off**: figuratively, of the body, [[2Co.5.4|2Co.5:4]]†
(AS)

G1568.def:
**ἐκ-θαμβέω**, -ῶ
(ἔκθαμβος), [in LXX: [[Sir.30.9|Sir.30:9]] * ;]
1. **to be amazed**.
2. **to amaze, terrify** ([[Sir.30.9|Sir.30:9]]). Pass., **to be amazed, terrified**: [[Mrk.9.15; 14.33; 16.5-6|Mrk.9:15 14:33 16:5-6]].†
(AS)

G1514.def:
**εἰρηνεύω**
(εἰρήνη), [in LXX chiefly for שׁלם, שׁקט ;]
1. **to bring to peace, reconcile** (so [[1Ma.6.60|1Ma.6:60]]).
2. **to keep peace, be at peace**: [[Mrk.9.50|Mrk.9:50]], [[Rom.12.18|Rom.12:18]], [[2Co.13.11|2Co.13:11]], [[1Th.5.13|1Th.5:13]] (cf. [[Sir.28.9|Sir.28:9]] Cremer, 246).
† (AS)

G1586.def:
**ἐκ-λέγω **
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
**to pick out, choose**. In NT always mid. (exc. [[Luk.9.35|Luk.9:35]], ἐκλελεγμένος, WH, ἀγαπητός, R, mg.), **to pick out for oneself, choose **(cf. M, _Pr._, 157 f.): with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.10.42; 14.7|Luk.10:42 14:7]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Act.6.5; 15.22, 25|Act.6:5 15:22, 25]]; of Christ (see supr.), [[Luk.9.35|Luk.9:35]] of Christ's choice of disciples, [[Luk.6.13|Luk.6:13]], [[Jhn.6.70; 13.18; 15.16, 19|Jhn.6:70 13:18 15:16, 19]] [[Act.1.2|Act.1:2]]; of the Divine choice: of persons, [[Mrk.13.20|Mrk.13:20]], [[Act.1.24; 13.17; 15.7|Act.1:24 13:17 15:7]], [[Eph.1.4|Eph.1:4]], [[Jas.2.5|Jas.2:5]]; of things, [[1Co.1.27-28|1Co.1:27-28]] (Cremer, 402, 773).†
(AS)

G1580.def:
**ἐκ-κομίζω **
**to carry out**: as freq., a corpse for burial, [[Luk.7.12|Luk.7:12]]†
(AS)

G1567.def:
**ἐκ-ζητέω, -ῶ**
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, also for נָצַר, בָּקַשׁ, etc. ;]
1. **to seek out **or **after, search for**: with accusative of person(s) ([[1Ma.9.26|1Ma.9:26]]); figuratively, τ. κύριον, θεόν (cf. [[Psa.14.2|Psa.14:2]], [[Amo.5.4|Amo.5:4]], al.), [[Act.15.17|Act.15:17]], [[Rom.3.11|Rom.3:11]], [[Heb.11.6|Heb.11:6]]; εὐλογίαν, [[Heb.12.17|Heb.12:17]] ἐξεζήτησαν κ. ἐξηραύνησαν (as in [[1Ma.9.26|1Ma.9:26]]), **sought and searched out**: [[1Pe.1.10|1Pe.1:10]]
2. As in [[2Ki.4.11|2Ki.4:11]], [[Ezk.3.18, 20|Eze.3:18, 20]] al. (דָּרַשׁ), **to demand, require**: [[Luk.11.50-51|Luk.11:50-51]] †
(AS)

G1587.def:
**ἐκ-λείπω **
[in LXX for כָּלָה, כָּרַת ni., תָּמַם, etc., 47 different words in all ;]
1. trans., **to leave out, pass over**.
2. Intrans., **to leave off, cease, fail**: μαμωνᾶς, [[Luk.16.9|Luk.16:9]] πίστις, [[Luk.22.32|Luk.22:32]] ἔτη, [[Heb.1.12|Heb.1:12]] (LXX); of the sun in an eclipse, [[Luk.23.45|Luk.23:45]]†
(AS)

G1592.def:
**ἐκ-μυκτηρίζω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.2.4; 22.7; 35.16|Psa.2:4 22:7 35:16]] (לָעַג), I [[Est.1.51|Est.1:51]] A* ;]
**to hold up the nose in derision at, scoff at**: with accusative, [[Luk.16.14; 23.35|Luk.16:14 23:35]].†
(AS)

G1556.def:
**ἐκδικέω**, -ῶ
(ἔκδικος), [in LXX for פָּקַד, נָקַם, שָׁפַט, etc. ;]
1. **to vindicate**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.18.3|Luk.18:3]], 5.
2. **to avenge**: with accusative of person(s), ἑαυτούς, [[Rom.12.19|Rom.12:19]] with accusative of thing(s), παρακοήν, [[2Co.10.6|2Co.10:6]] αἷμα, [[Rev.6.10; 19.2|Rev.6:10 19:2]] (Cremer, 203; for exx. from π. in both senses, see MM, _Exp._, xii).†
(AS)

G1557.def:
**ἐκ-δίκησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐκδικέω), [in LXX chiefly for נָקָם ;]
**vengeance, vindication**: [[Luk.21.22|Luk.21:22]], [[Rom.12.19|Rom.12:19]] (see MM, _Exp._, xii), [[Heb.10.30|Heb.10:30]] (LXX), [[2Co.7.11|2Co.7:11]] of the injured person, with genitive, [[Luk.18.7-8;|Luk.18:7-8]] with dative, [[Act.7.24|Act.7:24]] of the offender, with genitive obj., [[1Pe.2.14|1Pe.2:14]] with dative, [[2Th.1.8|2Th.1:8]] (cf. [[Sir.12.6|Sir.12:6]]).†
(AS)

G1582.def:
**ἐκ-κρέμαννυμι**,
[in LXX for קָשַׁר, [[Gen.44.30|Gen.44:30]] * ;]
**to hang from or upon**; mid., ἐκκρέμαμαι: figuratively, ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ άκούων (Rec.; WH read ἐξεκρέμετο, which implies a Pres. ἐκκρέμομαι, otherwise unknown; cf. Veitch, see word κρέμαμαι), [[Luk.19.48|Luk.19:48]]†
(AS)

G1574.def:
**ἐκ-κεντέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּקַר ;]
1. **to prick out, put out** (Arist.).
2. **to pierce** (Polyb., LXX): with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.19.37|Jhn.19:37]] (LXX), [[Rev.1.7|Rev.1:7]]†
(AS)

G1560.def:
**ἔκ-δοτος**, -ον
(ἐκδίδωμι), [in LXX: Da TH [[Bel.1.22|Bel 1:22]] * ;]
**given up, delivered over**: [[Act.2.23|Act.2:23]] (for construction, see Field, _Notes_, 111 f.).†
(AS)

G1524.def:
**εἴσ-ειμι **
[in LXX for בּוֹא ;]
**to go in, enter**: before εἰς, [[Act.3.3; 21.26|Act.3:3 21:26]], [[Heb.9.6|Heb.9:6]]; πρὸς Ἰάκωβον, [[Act.21.18|Act.21:18]]†
(AS)

G1569.def:
**ἔκ-θαμβος**, -ον
(θάμβος), [in LXX: [[Wis.10.19|Wis.10:19]], Da TH [[Dan.7.7|Dan.7:7]] (**dreadful, terrible**: אֵמְתָּנִי) * ;]
**amazed** (cf. Polyb., xx, 10, 9): [[Act.3.11|Act.3:11]]†
(AS)

G1589.def:
**ἐκλογή**, ῆς ἡ
(ἐκλέγω), [in Aq.: [[Isa.22.7|Isa.22:7]] Sm., _Th._: [[Isa.37.24|Isa.37:24]] * ;]
**a choice, selection**; in NT, always of the Divine choice (EV, election): σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς, genitive qual., a chosen vessel; κατ ἐ., [[Rom.9.11; 11.5, 28|Rom.9:11 11:5, 28]]; with genitive of person(s), [[1Th.1.4|1Th.1:4]], [[2Pe.1.10|2Pe.1:10]]; by meton., ἡ ἐ. = οἱ ἐκλεκτοί, [[Rom.11.7|Rom.11:7]]†
(AS)

G1528.def:
**εἰσ-καλέω, -ῶ**,
**to call in**: mid., with accusative of person(s), [[Act.10.23|Act.10:23]]†
(AS)

G1529.def:
**εἴσ-οδος, -ου, ὁ**
(ὁδός) [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
1. **a means of entering, place of entrance**: [[Heb.10.19|Heb.10:19]], [[2Pe.1.11|2Pe.1:11]] (cf. Westc., He., l.with; MM, _Exp._, xii; but see infr.).
2. **a going in, entrance**: [[Act.13.24|Act.13:24]] with genitive loc., [[Heb.10.19|Heb.10:19]] (Thayer, see word; but see supr.); before εἰς, [[2Pe.1.11|2Pe.1:11]] (Mayor, in l.; Thayer; but see supr.); πρός, [[2Th.1.9; 2.1|2Th.1:9 2:1]].†
(AS)

G1555.def:
**ἐκ-δι-ηγέομαι**, -οῦμαι depon.,
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר, pi. ;]
**to tell in detail, relate, declare**: [[Act.13.41|Act.13:41]] (LXX) [[Act.15.3|Act.15:3]]†
(AS)

G1530.def:
**εἰσ-πηδάω, -ῶ**
[in LXX: [[Amo.5.19|Amo.5:19]] (בּוֹא), Da TH [[Sus.1.26|Sus 1:26]]* ;]
**to spring in, rush in**: [[Act.14.14|Act.14:14]] (Rec.), [[Act.16.29|Act.16:29]] (for exx. from π., see MM, _Exp._, xii).†
(AS)

G1551.def:
**ἐκ-δέχομαι **
[in LXX for עֶרֶב, קָבַץ, etc. ;]
1. **to take** or **receive from** (Hom., Hdt., a1.).
2. (Rare in cl.), **to expect, await**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Jhn.5.3|Jhn.5:3]], [[Heb.11.10|Heb.11:10]], [[Jas.5.7|Jas.5:7]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Act.17.16|Act.17:16]], [[1Co.11.33; 16.11|1Co.11:33 16:11]]; before ἕως, [[Heb.10.13|Heb.10:13]] (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)

G1566.def:
**ἐκεῖσε **
_adv._, [in LXX: [[Job.39.29|Job.39:29]] שָׁם * ;]
**thither**: [[Act.21.3|Act.21:3]] constr. pregn. (MM, _Exp._, xii; Field, _Notes_, 134), τοὺς ἐ. ὄντας, [[Act.22.5|Act.22:5]]†
(AS)

G1546.def:
**ἐκ-βολή**, -ῆς
(ἐκβάλλω), [in LXX: [[Exo.11.1|Exo.11:1]] (גָּרַשׁ), [[Jos.1.5|Jos.1:5]] (ἐκβολὴν ποιεῖσθαι, טול hi.), [[Ezk.47.8|Eze.47:8]] (יָצָא)* ;]
1. **a throwing out**.
2. **a jettison, a throwing overboard of cargo**: [[Act.27.18|Act.27:18]] (cf. Jos, l.with; and see Field, _Notes_, 144 f.).†
(AS)

G1572.def:
**ἐκ-καίω **
[in LXX chiefly for בָּעַר ;]
1. **to burn up**.
2. **to kindle**. Pass., **to burn**: metaphorically, of the passions (cf. [[Sir.16.6|Sir.16:6]], [[Job.3.17|Job.3:17]]), [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]].†
(AS)

G1578.def:
**ἐκ-κλίνω **
[in LXX for נָטָה, סוּר, etc. ;]
intrans., **to turn aside, turn away**: metaphorically, **from the right path**, absol., [[Rom.3.12|Rom.3:12]] (LXX); from evil, absol., [[1Pe.3.11|1Pe.3:11]] before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), [[Rom.16.17|Rom.16:17]]†
(AS)

G1576.def:
**ἐκ-κλείω **
[in LXX: ἐ. κρίσιν, for נָטָה hi., [[Exo.23.2|Exo.23:2]] (also as seel., [[Job.34.20|Job.34:20]], [[Psa.67.1-7|Psa.67:1-7]] ([[Psa.68.30|Psa.68:30]]) * ;]
**to shut out**: [[Gal.4.17|Gal.4:17]] Pass., [[Rom.3.27|Rom.3:27]]†
(AS)

G1541.def:
**ἑκατονταετής** (Rec. έτης), **-ές **
(ἑκατόν, ἔτης) [in LXX for שָׁנֶה מֵאָה בֵּן, [[Gen.17.17|Gen.17:17]] * ;]
**a hundred years old**: [[Rom.4.19|Rom.4:19]]†
(AS)

G1535.def:
**εἴτε**, see: εἰ.
**εἰ**,
_conjunctive particle_, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, **if**;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[Mat.11.14|Mat.11:14]], [[Rom.8.25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[Mrk.4.23; 9.22|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[Jhn.15.18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1Co.7.9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[Luk.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[Rom.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[Mat.12.26|Mat.12:26]], [[Rom.4.14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[Luk.17.6|Luk.17:6]], [[Jhn.8.39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[Mat.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[Jhn.5.47; 7.23; 8.46|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]];
(b) fut.: [[Mat.26.33|Mat.26:33]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]];
(with) pf.: [[Jhn.11.12|Jhn.11:12]], [[Rom.6.5|Rom.6:5]], al.;
(d) aor.: [[Luk.16.11; 19.8|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[Jhn.13.32; 18.23|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[Rev.20.15|Rev.20:15]], al.
2. **Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί**: [[Mat.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[Jhn.7.4|Jhn.7:4]], [[Rom.5.17|Rom.5:17]], al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1Jn.3.13|1Jn.3:13]], al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[Num.14.3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1Sa.14.45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[Mrk.8.12|Mrk.8:12]], [[Heb.3.11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, **to express a merely possible condition**: [[Act.24.19; 27.39|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1Co.14.10; 15.37|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, **if, whether**.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[Mat.26.63|Mat.26:63]], [[Mrk.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[2Co.13.5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[Mrk.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[Act.8.22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1Co.1.16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, _Pr._, 194), [[Php.3.12|Php.3:12]]
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[Gen.17.17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), **in direct questions**: [[Mrk.8.23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[Luk.13.23; 22.49|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, **but if also**: [[Luk.11.18|Luk.11:18]] **but even if**, [[1Co.4.7|1Co.4:7]], [[2Co.4.3; 11.16|2Co.4:3 11:16]].
3. εἰ δὲ μή, **but if not, but if otherwise**: [[Mrk.2.21, 22|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[Jhn.14.2|Jhn.14:2]], [[Rev.2.5|Rev.2:5]], al.
4. εἰ καί, **if even, if also, although**: [[Mrk.14.29|Mrk.14:29]], [[Luk.11.8|Luk.11:8]], [[1Co.7.21|1Co.7:21]], [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]], [[Php.2.17|Php.2:17]], al.
5. καὶ εἰ, **even if**, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, **if not, unless, except, but only**: [[Mat.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[Mrk.2.26; 6.5|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[Jhn.9.33|Jhn.9:33]], [[1Co.7.17|1Co.7:17]] (**only**), [[Gal.1.19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., _Ja._, xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[1Co.14.5; 15.2|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1Ti.5.19|1Ti.5:19]].
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, _Pr._, 46), in oaths, **surely** ([[Ezk.33.27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[Heb.6.14|Heb.6:14]].
8. εἴ πως, **if haply**: [[Act.27.12|Act.27:12]], [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]].
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, **whether . . . or**; [[Rom.12.6-8|Rom.12:6-8]], [[1Co.3.22; 13.8|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al.
(AS)

G1500.def:
**εἰκῇ** (-ῆ, Rec., as in cl.), _adv._,
[in LXX: [[Pro.28.25|Pro.28:25]] (εἰκῇ)* ;]
1. **without cause** or **reason**: [[Mat.5.22|Mat.5:22]] (E, mg.), [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]] (_ICC_).
2. **vainly, fruitlessly, to no purpose**: [[Rom.13.4|Rom.13:4]], [[1Co.15.2|1Co.15:2]], [[Gal.3.4; 4.11|Gal.3:4 4:11]], [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]].
† (AS)

G1558.def:
**ἔκδικος**, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX: [[Wis.12.12|Wis.12:12]], [[Sir.30.6|Sir.30:6]], [[4Ma.15.29|4Ma.15:29]] * ;]
1. **without law, unjust**.
2. **exacting penalty from**; as subst., **an avenger**: [[Rom.13.4|Rom.13:4]] before περί, [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (in π., _a legal representative_; Milligan, _Th._, l.with).†
(AS)

G1571.def:
**ἐκ-καθαίρω **
[in LXX for בָּעַר, etc. ;]
1. **to cleanse thoroughly, cleanse out**: with accusative, ἑαυτόν, [[2Ti.2.21|2Ti.2:21]] of the impurity removed, ζυμήν, [[1Co.5.7|1Co.5:7]]†
(AS)

G1594.def:
**ἐκ-νήφω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.9.24|Gen.9:24]], [[Hab.2.7|Hab.2:7]] (יָקַץ), [[Jol.1.5|Jol.1:5]], [[Hab.2.19|Hab.2:19]] (יָקַץ hi.), [[1Sa.25.37|1Ki.25:37]] (יָצָא), [[Sir.31.2|Sir.31:2]] * ;]
**to become sober after drunkenness**: metaphorically, of sobriety of mind, [[1Co.15.34|1Co.15:34]]†
(AS)

G1553.def:
**ἐκ-δημέω**, -ῶ
(ἔκδημος, _from home_; cf. -ία, [[3Ma.4.11|3Ma.4:11]])*;
**to be from home, absent**: [[2Co.5.6|2Co.5:6]] before ἀπό, [[2Co.5.8|2Co.5:8]] before ἐκ, [[2Co.5.9|2Co.5:9]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐνδημέω).†
(AS)

G1550.def:
**εκ-δαπανάω**, -ῶ
strengthened form of δαπανάω, **to spend wholly**; pass., with reflexive force, **to spend oneself wholly**: before ὑπέρ, [[2Co.12.15|2Co.12:15]]†
(AS)

G1559.def:
**ἐκ-διώκω **
[in LXX for בָּרַח hi., צָמַת, הָדַף, etc. ;]
**to chase away, drive out**: [[1Th.2.15|1Th.2:15]] (cf. [[Deu.6.19|Deu.6:19]], [[Jol.2.20|Jol.2:20]]).†
(AS)

G1549.def:
**ἔκ-γονος**, -ον
(ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;]
1. with genitive, **born of**.
2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., **a child, son or daughter**; in pl., **descendants**: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., **children or grand-children**, [[1Ti.5.4|1Ti.5:4]]†
(AS)

G1552.def:
**ἔκ-δηλος**, -ον
(δῆλος), [in LXX: [[3Ma.3.19|3Ma.3:19]] [[3Mac.6.5|3Mac 6:5]] * ;]
strengthened form of δῆλος, which see, **quite clear, evident**: [[2Ti.3.9|2Ti.3:9]]†
(AS)

G1595.def:
**ἐκούσιος**, -ον
(έκών), [in LXX chiefly for נְדָבָה, as [[Num.15.3|Num.15:3]] (κατ᾽ ἑ) ;]
usually of actions, **voluntary**: κατὰ ἑ., of free will (Lft., in l), Phm 14.†
(AS)

G1561.def:
**ἐκ-δοχή ῆς**, ἡ
(ἐκδέχομαι);
1. in cl.,
(a) **a receiving from, succession**;
(b) **an interpretation**.
2. In NT, = προσδοκία, **expectation**: [[Heb.10.27|Heb.10:27]] (cf. Field, _Notes_, 231; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)

G1585.def:
**ἐκ-λανθάνω **
[in Sm.: [[Psa.13.2|Psa.13:2]] * ;]
**to escape notice utterly**; mid., **to forget utterly**: [[Heb.12.5|Heb.12:5]]†
(AS)

G1503.def:
**εἴκω** (obsolete pres.), see: ἔοικα Transcriber note: This form does not occur in Abbott-Smith. It should be on p. 158..
(AS)

G1597.def:
**ἔκ-παλαι **
_adv._ (of a class of compound adverbs common in late Gk.; see Mayor on 2 Pe, l.with),
**for a long time, from of old**: [[2Pe.2.3; 3.5|2Pe.2:3 3:5]].†
(AS)
